_comment: Tools for the investigating model (see py/oncall_agent/Agents/ — one folder
per specialist, assembled by Agents/registry.py).
noc_slack    read-only Slack: what #comms-noc did for this alert before. Every
specialist gets this one — history/case grounding is universal.
noc_grafana  search dashboards, read what a panel queries, run PromQL, render a
panel. Given to the Grafana/Metrics and Kubernetes specialists.
noc_k8s      read-only kubectl against the kubeconfigs under ~/eks (see
Agents/K8S_Agent/kubectl_client.py's credential note): unhealthy pods,
a pod's state/events, its logs, and whether its replica peers are
running. Given to the Kubernetes specialist only. Fixed read verbs,
validated names, stage-only unless KUBE_ENVIRONMENTS says otherwise.
noc_aws      read-only AWS via the operator's own `aws` SSO session (see
Agents/AWS_Agent/aws_client.py's credential note): RDS instance detail,
CloudWatch numbers AND server-rendered graph PNGs, Performance Insights
top SQL, RDS events. Given to the AWS specialist only. Allow-listed
read-only subcommands — no modify/reboot/delete path exists.
noc_windows  read-only Windows VM detail: top processes by CPU/memory. Prefers
windows_exporter metrics already in Thanos (93 hosts, NO login); falls
back to a fixed set of read-only WinRM queries for hosts without an
exporter (WINDOWS_USERNAME/PASSWORD in .env). Query-shaped, not
command-shaped — see Agents/Windows_Agent/winrm_client.py.
noc_edge_ui  aiWARE Edge/Controller task stats, task detail, screenshots, log
download. Given to the Edge UI/engine specialist only.
noc_runscope one tool: look up the current run of the Runscope test matching an
alert. Given to the Runscope specialist only.
noc_github   read-only GitHub via `gh` CLI (already authenticated on this machine,
see Agents/Github_Agent/github_client.py's credential note): search
code, read a file, check a PR/commit, list workflow runs. Given to the
Edge UI/engine specialist, so it can verify real code/deploy state
instead of trusting a case-library note.
noc_jira     read-only Jira Cloud REST API (JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN in .env, see
Agents/Jira_Agent/jira_client.py): search for and read an EXISTING
ticket that already tracks this exact issue. Given to every
specialist — unlike GitHub, a relevant Jira ticket isn't specific to
one alert domain (2026-08-26 example: Rekognition throttling, a
Runscope Track Job failure, and a PandoLogic disk alert all had one).
All read-only apart from render_panel/capture_*_screenshot/download_*_logs,
which write evidence files into dist/evidence. None can post to Slack — the bot
token does that, in our code, after validation.
"command": "python" is only a fallback for running `claude` by hand from an
activated venv. investigate.py/Agents/registry.py rewrite this at run time to the
interpreter the agent itself is running under, so servers always have their deps.
